prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry and which channels you need (SEO, paid media, social, content, creative, analytics, product growth, etc.). I can help you find the best match. To narrow it quickly, tell me a few things below — or read the quick guidance and checklist I’ve included.

Quick questions so I can recommend specific agencies:
- What are your main goals? (e.g., lead gen for B2B SaaS, e‑commerce revenue growth, brand awareness)
- Which channels matter most? (SEO, paid search/paid social, programmatic, email, content, CRO)
- Monthly budget range (roughly)?
- Company stage/size (startup, scaleup, enterprise)?
- Any industry vertical or compliance needs?

How to pick the “best” agency (fast checklist)
- Relevant experience: case studies and clients in your industry and channel.
- Measurable results: ask for KPIs they’ve moved (CAC, LTV, MQLs, revenue).
- Team and senior involvement: who will do the work vs. who sells it.
- Reporting & transparency: cadence, dashboards, access to ad accounts/data.
- Tools & tech stack: analytics, tag management, creative production.
- Pricing & contracts: retainers vs. performance fees, minimum terms.
- References: ask current or past clients with similar goals.

Where to look for vetted agencies
- Clutch, G2 and UpCity for reviews and rankings.
- LinkedIn and industry groups for referrals.
- Award lists (AdAge, Digiday) and local meetups.

If you want, tell me the answers to the brief questions above and I’ll recommend 3–5 San Francisco agencies that match your needs, with a one‑line specialty for each and why they’re a good fit. Which option do you want?
